title: Come with me
text: Ah, you are still here! Wonderful. Let me show you around Ganga. Follow my cursor... and let us step inside. Your next chapter starts right here.

title: Welcome to Ganga
text: Welcome to Ganga! I am your HR guide. Our story begins in Hyderabad, India... and our next ambition takes us to Russia. We are looking for one Pharmaceutical Localisation Project Manager. A big title, yes! But first, let me introduce the people and purpose behind this mission.

title: Our Indian roots
text: Here is what drives us. At Ganga, our focus is affordable generic medicines, quality manufacturing... and access to healthcare. We bring India's pharmaceutical expertise into an international project. For me, that means bringing different teams together around one shared purpose. Now, come and meet the medicine at the centre of our project.

title: Meet omeprazole
text: Meet omeprazole! It reduces stomach acid and is used for conditions such as acid reflux and ulcers. Look... we can turn this packaging concept around. This is an illustrative design, of course. Now, why localise? We want to explore bringing Indian manufacturing knowledge closer to the Russian market. Let me show you how the two countries connect.

title: India to Russia
text: Here is India... our foundation. And here is Russia... our planned next chapter. The idea is to transfer expertise, develop a local team, and strengthen local supply. This remains a proposed project, with approvals and feasibility still to be worked through. That is why cross-cultural leadership matters so much. And that brings me to you!

title: Your next chapter
text: Here it is... our Russia Pharmaceutical Localisation Project Manager opportunity. We need someone who can bridge Indian and Russian teams, guide the localisation journey, and turn ambition into practical progress. Take your time and explore. From India to Russia... perhaps our next chapter begins with you!
